name: chopnow
description: ChopNow — community food ordering and delivery marketplace (MVP monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @chopnow/api
scripts.dev:customer: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @chopnow/customer-mobile
scripts.dev:vendor: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @chopnow/vendor-web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && npm run test:integration -w @chopnow/api
scripts.dev:rider: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @chopnow/rider-mobile
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @chopnow/admin-web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @chopnow/e2e && npm run e2e -w @chopnow/e2e
